g.text: Some books hide their darkest secrets in the margins.

text.font-family: Baskerville, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
text.tspan: When a reclusive town historian is found poisoned at a rare book
auction in the misty Blue Ridge foothills, antiquarian bookshop owner
Callie Thorne is the only one who notices what the police missed:
a coded message handwritten in the victim’s catalog.
For Callie, marginalia isn’t just an academic curiosity — it’s a gift.
Decoding the faded notes tucked inside old volumes is what she does
better than anyone. But this time the trail leads far deeper than a
single murder. Every note points toward a decades-old scandal buried
The sheriff sees a meddling shopkeeper. The killer sees a threat that
needs silencing. With an innocent man already in the crosshairs,
Callie faces an impossible choice: let a killer walk free, or expose the
truth and watch her community shatter.

g.text: "Smart, atmospheric bookish mystery with real emotional stakes."
